cohort_rule: cohorts with fewer than 5 observed cells and unobserved cohorts: linear extrapolation from the 15 cohorts before them
alternative_rule: every observed cohort keeps its estimate; only unobserved cohorts are extrapolated, from the last 15 observed cohorts (the rule changes both the cohorts extrapolated and the cohorts the line is fitted to)

backtest.error: observed minus forecast for life-table measures; log(observed rate / forecast rate) for age bands

age_band_backtest_weights: 2019 exposure (known only after the forecast origin; used for scoring, not for fitting)
